use_case_summary:
Primary workloads: customer support chat assistant for transaction queries (chat, streaming responses), embeddings for internal docs and KB (semantic search), and reranking for fraud signals (latency sensitive for alerting).
Targets: 95th perc latency under 300ms for typical chat responses (short context), burst QPS ~40, steady-state throughput ~200 reqs/min during business hours. Cost sensitivity: moderate-high; POC budget cap $2k/month for trial.
Model preferences: open to open-source models (Llama/Redwood-verified variants) or hosted high-capacity models if price/latency fits. Wants routing fallback to smaller quantized model when cost SLO exceeded.
Security & compliance: Okta SSO for admin, audit logs retained 90 days for POC, SOC2 evidence required for procurement, KMS for key management later.
Notes on operations: will need clear observability per-route token and latency metrics; request for sample dashboard and billing breakdown during POC.
demo_feedback: Positive on API ergonomics and console. Concern: unclear billing behavior for streaming tokens vs. final tokens — asked for token accounting examples. Liked Optimize suggestions for batching; wants prescriptive config for their QPS pattern.
